create_unispeech_model: create a UniSpeechModel for audio feature extraction with configurable encoder and stable layer norm
run_unispeech_pretraining: run UniSpeechForPreTraining with gumbel vector quantization and contrastive learning on audio inputs
run_unispeech_ctc: run UniSpeechForCTC for automatic speech recognition with CTC loss on audio sequences
run_unispeech_classification: run UniSpeechForSequenceClassification for audio sequence classification tasks
